exclusion: Only currently retired pools with latest reported retirement before lookback_first_epoch minus two. Total reconciliation is required before treating absent rows as zero.
snapshot_semantics: Effective election stake. epoch_stake at epoch E is populated from mark in E-1, which becomes set in E. API source code and db-sync extraction code are pinned in sources.json.
native_node_comparison: No independently operated historical mainnet node available. This dataset is provider reported. Code-level epoch alignment and exact total reconciliation are recorded separately.
ordered_block_sampling: Eleven epochs chosen every ten epochs from the first transition, plus the last analysis epoch. All blocks in each sampled epoch are requested.
